{{Top|ca|leg}}
'''Onsible''' was an [[Ultraviolet/Legends|ultraviolet]] [[Color/Legends|color]] visible to members of the [[Nediji]] and the [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Most other beings were unable to see the color, and few [[Language/Legends|languages]] had a name for it.<ref name="MIIJH">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref> In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]'' to [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> the Umbaran [[Squa Tront]] wore a garment called a [[Shadowcloak (clothing)|shadowcloak]] while meeting with the Nediji [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Kaird]], who observed that Tront's shadowcloak was a mixture of colors such as onsible, [[Berl (color)|berl]], [[crynor]], and [[nusp]], which swirled together in a way that Kaird considered beautiful.<ref name="MIIJH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Onsible appeared in the [[2004]] novel ''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]'', written by [[Steve Perry]] and [[Michael Reaves]] as the second entry in the ''[[MedStar Duology]]''.<ref name="MIIJH" />
